articles.summary: DineSafe is excited to participate in and present at the 13th Poultry Federation Annual Food Safety Conference on March 4-6, 2025, in Hot Springs, Arkansas. We will have the opportunity to discuss the innovative use of consumer crowdsourcing for monitoring real-time food safety trends. This conference is a space for industry representatives, food safety professionals, and the academic community to discuss and discover critical information on food safety, quality, and compliance challenges.
articles.title: DineSafe at the 13t Poultry Federation Annual Food Safety Conference
